description.value: Hara Sushi is a licensed Japanese and Korean restaurant located in the Village Food Market in central Sooke, BC. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients — reviewers note fish caught the same day — and the small but efficient operation has earned a strong local reputation. A touring cyclist stopping in Sooke will find both dine-in and take-out options served by attentive staff.
